eyebrow: PROF. STUART GRAY, UNIVERSITY OF GLASGOW
headline: Protecting muscle is [[the question at the heart of our program.]]
body: Prof. Gray is an investigator on LEAN-PREP, an independent randomised controlled trial of resistance training and protein.

eyebrow: PROF. STUART GRAY, UNIVERSITY OF GLASGOW
headline: Why does a metabolic health program [[need a muscle scientist?]]
body: His research focuses on sarcopenia, the loss of muscle mass and strength, and how resistance exercise and nutrition counter it.
